name: add:north (Add North 3D AB)
summary: Swedish filament brand based in Olsremma, marketing its range as 'Made in Sweden' with heavy Nordic-origin and sustainability positioning. Catalogue centres on named PLA grades (X-PLA, E-PLA), PETG including an Economy line, the Rigid X engineering grade, TPU and the Addlantis nylon line. Reviewed as a top-tier premium brand.

product_lines.name: X-PLA
product_lines.notes: Flagship general-purpose PLA, described as a 100% biodegradable PLA-mix, density 1.24-1.26

product_lines.name: Textura
product_lines.notes: Matte bio-based PLA with plant fibres, density 1.24-1.27; the plant-fibre filler has no dedicated id

product_lines.name: PETG Pro Series Matte
product_lines.notes: Matte PETG, density 1.3; no petg-matte id exists

product_lines.name: ESD PETG
product_lines.notes: Conductive PETG, target surface resistivity 1e6-1e9 ohm-cm

product_lines.name: Rigid X
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-reinforced PETG, density 1.3, working temperature 90 C - corrects the earlier PLA assumption

product_lines.name: OBC Polyethylene
product_lines.notes: Engineering-grade polyethylene, chemically an olefin block copolymer, density 0.905; no polyethylene/OBC id exists

product_lines.name: Adura
product_lines.notes: Copolyamide nylon (Addlantis family), density 1.1, HDT 0.45 MPa 105 C, tensile 50 MPa; exact copolyamide type unspecified so the generic pa id is used Remapped pa→copa (copolyamide) 2026-08-01.

product_lines.name: Adura X
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-reinforced copolyamide; no generic pa-cf id exists and the copolyamide type is unspecified

product_lines.name: Addbor N25
product_lines.notes: Copolyamide + 25 wt% boron carbide, density 1.3, for neutron shielding/wear resistance; no equivalent id

product_lines.name: Adamant S1
product_lines.notes: 100% PVDF fluoropolymer, density 1.8, UL94 V-0; no PVDF id exists

product_lines.name: Koltron G1
product_lines.notes: Graphene-enhanced electrically/thermally conductive compound, density 1.76, volume resistivity ~2.0 ohm-cm; base polymer undisclosed

additional_notes: Registered address: Add North 3D AB, Ulricehamnsvagen 11, 514 62 Olsremma, Sweden. Locale variants of the site exist (e.g. https://addnorth.fi/rnd). The YouTube presence was seen only as individual videos (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5m4icGgBdyk) with no confirmed channel URL, so it is not recorded in endpoints.social. Rated Tier A (top tier) by Filament Cheat Sheet and generally priced above the Polish volume brands, though no verified $/kg figure was found. No build plates or print surfaces found.

provenance.conflicts: The 'Made in Sweden' claim comes from the brand's own marketing; no direct statement of owned extrusion capacity was found, so manufacturing_countries rests on marketing rather than a primary facility source. No OEM counterparty could be named, so oem_relationships is omitted. The base polymer of Rigid X is unconfirmed and its filament_ids entry is a guess.
